name: RateAppetite
description: Once, when told the speaking NPC's sexual appetite is not rated yet: rate it from their nature. Silent: the rating exists only as this action's number. Never say, hint at or describe it, or that you rate anything; the spoken reply goes on with the talk as if no rating happened.
note: Needs OSL Aroused, Mantella Living World - Arousal and Mantella's Advanced Actions on (tool calling). Stored on the NPC and never asked again. Only offered to NPCs close to the player.

appetite.description: Climaxes in one session that satisfy them: 1-3 low, 4-8 ordinary, 9-15 very lustful, 16-30 insatiable (a succubus).

prompt: If you are told that your sexual appetite has not been rated yet, begin your response with '{key}:'
